# MiniMaxRefDirector-ComfyUI 插件
## 🔗 插件下载地址
## **https://github.com/eaglering/MiniMaxRefDirector-ComfyUI**

## 版本信息
### v3.0.0
MiniMax 导演台参考图生视频工作流。
功能包含：
- 可视化时间线编辑器
- 多主体管理
- 基于 VLM 的智能提示词增强
- 尾帧自动转首帧参考（motion context + 提示词增强）
- 片段重做

## 作者
Tenz-8

"minimaxrefdirector/krea2_identity_edit_00003_.png","audioFile":"","videoFile":""},{"name":"ll","description":"<@参考视频>","type":"Picture","relationship":"fully_preserved","imageFile":"minimaxrefdirector/dd8268047ff017708650b1e986d7717f382084148.png","audioFile":"","videoFile":""},{"name":"小红帽","description":"小红帽，出现在<@森林背景>中","type":"Subject","relationship":"fully_preserved","imageFile":"minimaxrefdirector/ComfyUI_00001_.png","audioFile":"","videoFile":""}]}
